notes:
Account: Crimson Harbor Inference (CH) — trading/market making platform exploring LLMs for ultra-low-latency decisioning. Strong emphasis on latency SLOs and predictable unit cost. Key ask: POC to prove p95 < 30ms and p99 tail behavior for short-chat/decision requests and embedding lookups.

Topline from discovery call (2026-02-18):
- CTO (Maya Singh): 'We will only consider providers that can show deterministic p99s under realistic bursts.'
- Engineering: wants a perf harness that can replay live traffic (short prompts, 20-80 tokens) and measure p50/p95/p99 and GPU utilization.
- Ops: wants VPC deployment or on-prem option for EU/residency customers; KMS integration required.

Technical constraints / priorities:
- Workloads: mix of extremely short chat prompts (10-40 tokens) for trade assistants, and embedding requests for real-time signal lookup.
- Latency targets: p95 <= 30ms for single-turn decision prompts; p99 <= 120ms. Burst throughput target: sustained 200 req/s per region, spikes to 800 req/s for market opens.
- Cost sensitivity: high — need clear token-level cost breakdown. Will evaluate batching and caching tradeoffs that don't violate latency SLOs.
- Model preferences: prefer Llama-3 / open models with quantized int8/int4 variants; fallback to smaller distilled models during overload.
- Ops needs: canary rollouts, route-by-region, automatic fallback to compatible model variant.

Requested Redwood capabilities:
- Benchmark kit and sample scripts to run perf measurements (p50/p95/p99) against dedicated pool and private VPC.
- Recommendations from Redwood Optimize: batching window suggestions, prefix/KV caching config, quantization profiles that balance perf vs quality.
- Console visibility: token-level cost breakdown and trace for slow requests to debug tail latency.

POC milestones discussed:
- 2026-03-11: provide benchmark harness + config example (done, Redwood sent initial scripts).
- 2026-03-18: run internal replay of production traffic with Redwood Optimize suggested batching off/on and KV prefix caching. Goal: measure delta in cost/token and tail latency.
- 2026-03-25: demo results to CTO + SRE; propose Dedicated trial (1 month) with a pinch of burst capacity.

Quotes/remarks from engineers in follow-up: 'Prefix KV cache looks promising — a lot of our requests reuse market context in the first 6 tokens.' Also: 'Need a reproducible quantized path — INT8 is okay, but want behavior checks vs FP16 for edge cases.'

Risk and blockers: legal needs answers on data residency for EU customers (proof of region isolation) and SOC2 compliance evidence. Procurement timeline tied to internal risk committee (meets monthly).

Sales notes / tactics: Emphasize Redwood's dedicated pools with predictable throughput, and Redwood Optimize report showing cost/perf tradeoffs. Offer to run a controlled benchmark showing quantization + KV cache vs baseline to demonstrate >30% cost reduction while keeping p95 within budget.

Short next steps: schedule infra POC run (engineering + SE), supply security artifacts to legal, prepare Dedicated trial agreement.
